inputs: Existing frozen causal instruction/two RGB/eight executed action features; no history, future query, state, pose, IDs or labels as probe input
targets: Current anchor/terminal SEE2 witnesses from original compiler, current and previous frame only; not first-seen or cumulative state
split: Original whole-house split:13 FIT families/6 houses,12 CHECK families/2 houses; exposed exploratory debug assets
deduplication: One row per causal input within family; assert same-input target consistency and no cross-split overlap
unknown: Mask each unknown target; exclude t=0 single-frame cases
loss: Minibatch weighted BCE, equal FIT family and available label class per target, identical sampled row schedules for both heads
report: All seeds and heads, TP/TN/FP/FN, recall/specificity/balanced accuracy by split, house and family; no best checkpoint/threshold selection
decision: Good current-witness decoding with poor late memory supports examining memory updates; poor decoding motivates feature/semantic inspection but cannot prove information absence
